lines.say: A woman tried to return a bag of dog food and got flowers instead.
Anna Brose's dog Gus had died a week earlier. She only wanted a refund.
caps: a week earlier. She wanted *a refund.*

lines.say: Chewy refunded her, said to donate the food, and sent flowers to her porch.
More than six hundred thousand people liked her tweet. All Chewy did was notice.
Been a minute. Chair's open Thursday.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
